title: Karpathy-Lightning Feature Bridge: Extract GPU-discovered indices → seed CPU islands

problem.summary: S14 receives REMOTE_PROMOTE from karpathy_lightning_0.21218 every ~25 cycles but brier stays at 0.22431. The promoted individual (random_forest, n_est=275, n_feat=106, src=karpathy_lightning_0.21218) uses TabICL-derived feature discovery on P100 GPU. When the same feature set runs on CPU tree islands without the GPU feature selection context, the 106 features degrade to fleet-average performance.
problem.root_cause: The 106 feature *indices* from the lightning checkpoint index into the full 7213-feature engine.py candidate space. But the feature importance ordering and interaction weights differ between TabICL (GPU attention-based) and ExtraTrees/RandomForest (CPU split-based). Promoting the index list without relearning importance = importing noise.
evidence: S14 brier stuck at 0.22431 for 485+ gens despite 100+ REMOTE_PROMOTE injections
Fleet best 0.22073 was achieved by S22 independently (venn_abers_fusion, no GPU seeding)
S15 gen=350 individual hit 0.2192 with 200-feat RF — INDEPENDENTLY, no lightning seed

proposal.step_1: Extract the actual feature NAMES (not just indices) from the karpathy_lightning_0.21218 checkpoint. The lightning script saves a feature_names list alongside model. Path: scripts/kaggle/nba_karpathy_loop.py output → data/checkpoints/lightning-best-*.pkl
proposal.step_2: Run SHAP importance on a quick CPU ExtraTrees fit over those 106 features using the existing 9551-game training set. Keep only the top 50 by SHAP value on CPU — this re-ranks for CPU tree compatibility.
proposal.step_3: POST /api/config to each island with a 'seed_features' payload containing the top-50 CPU-reranked feature names. This bypasses the full GA feature search and directly tests whether the GPU-discovered feature NAMES (not ranks) are genuinely predictive on CPU.
proposal.step_4: If 2+ islands improve within 10 cycles, commit the top-50 list to features/engine.py as a 'priority_seed' hint for the GA initializer. If no improvement, conclude lightning features are GPU-specific and remove REMOTE_PROMOTE.

quick_win_alternative.title: S15 gen=350 hidden gem checkpoint
quick_win_alternative.detail: S15 logs show a generation-350 individual: brier=0.2192, ROI=33.53%, sharpe=9.928, 200-feat RandomForest. If this is a true holdout score, it beats the fleet record 0.22073. Action: POST /api/command {command: boost_mutation} to S15 immediately after its diversify lands, to explore the neighborhood of this individual. Also extract its feature list via /api/status?details=true and compare with S18's 51-feat extra_trees (brier=0.22248) — overlap may reveal the high-value feature cluster.
quick_win_alternative.estimated_impact: Potential new fleet record if holdout-confirmed
quick_win_alternative.implementation: VM cron or next brain cycle: curl /api/status?details=true on S15 after gen 355-360

cross_project_port.political: Political islands use only 272 feature candidates (vs NBA 7213). The same reranking approach (GPU-name → CPU-SHAP top-50) could be applied to political if a GPU political run ever produces a strong individual. Not applicable now — no political GPU run has occurred.
